about: The judging benchmark for challenger models (owner decisions 11 and D15). Each item is a question with one correct and one incorrect answer; each is judged as a claim. Answers must be unambiguous: a question whose answer depends on convention does not belong here.

review.drafted: 2026-09-27, by Claude (batch 12, phase AW); every answer checked by the drafter
review.reviewed_by: Piotr (owner), 2026-09-27: approved as drafted, relying on the drafter's checks, without an item-by-item review
review.how_to_approve: Check each item. Fix or delete any you disagree with, then set status to "reviewed" and reviewed_by to your name. Until then no model's challenges count, whatever it scores.

removed.question: how many continents are there?
removed.why: convention-dependent: seven, six and five are all taught, so a model accepting 'Five' is not clearly wrong
